description: This source file contains unit tests for Orleans serialization codecs, focusing on built-in types such as primitives, enums, DateTime, tuples, arrays, and various .NET system types. It uses the Xunit framework and closes testing coverage for many types with dedicated test classes, including serialization and deep copying functionalities.
